column11: JUDGEMENT. NCT06006559 completes 2027-07-22 (ClinicalTrials.gov, updated 2026-09-15), no Phase 3 is registered and Novartis gives no submission year. Novartis's own gap from a Phase 2b completion to a Phase 3 start is remibrutinib's 10.5 months (NCT03926611 completed 2021-01-14, NCT05030311 started 2021-11-30), so a Phase 3 starts about June 2028. June 2028 plus 1.88 years is April 2030, so 2031 is the first full year on sale
